rationale: C21 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Its opening closely parallels the child's distinctive progression from long-standing awareness of the official's need to leave, through regret, to acceptance; both then praise difficult, complex responsibilities using closely related language about judgment, service, and reassurance before ending with thanks and warm regard. C10 is also notably close, especially in its resignation-letter structure and promise of future availability, but C21 has the stronger clause-level verbal correspondence. C25 shares the same general structure but less distinctive wording.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Although I have long been aware of the considerations that require you to resume your University duties—and have fully appreciated them—I nevertheless regret that the time is now at hand when I must accept your resignation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: While I have long been aware that you would not be able to carry on indefinitely as Director of the Budget, it is with deepest regret that I accept the fact that personal obligations compel you to leave Government
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel opening: long prior awareness of personal constraints, explicit regret, and acceptance of departure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In this complex and exacting work, your vision and sound judgment have been of the highest value.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Budgetary responsibilities are always heavy and complex... courage, unflagging effort, and broad sympathetic understanding have been indispensable requirements... It is a tribute to your wise judgment and devoted service
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize the work as unusually complex and praise the departing official's judgment and service in closely parallel terms.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have drawn constant reassurance from the fact that your many abilities were devoted to the vital task... The nation has indeed profited by your dedication to this service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is a tribute to your wise judgment and devoted service that we have reached our present reassuring position... To my sincere thanks for your fine contribution
shared_material.explanation: Shared reassurance/service/contribution vocabulary supports direct drafting reuse beyond generic resignation-letter conventions.
